title: End-to-end calibration + accuracy regression bench for mixed FP8/INT8 variants with batching and long-context
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce an auditable, reproducible benchmarking pipeline that validates calibration profiles (FP8 and INT8 variants) end-to-end: calibration artifacts -> accuracy regression on evaluation suites -> throughput/latency matrix across batching and long-context workloads. Motivation: current quantization benchmarks focus on isolated throughput or single-sequence accuracy. We need a single canonical run that surfaces accuracy regressions caused by calibration heuristics and shows performance trade-offs when batching and KV cache behaviour interact with quantized kernels over long sequence horizons.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible CI job that runs calibration -> export profile -> run accuracy eval -> run perf matrix and uploads artifacts to GCS/BigQuery
Clear pass/fail thresholds defined for deltas in perplexity/EM and token-level bias metrics between FP16 baseline and each quantized variant
Grafana dashboard with latency P50/P95 and throughput curves for each variant (FP8 block-fp, FP8-e4m3, INT8 symmetric/asymmetric) across batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16] and context lengths [512,2048,8192]
Documentation describing calibration knobs used, stable seed and datasets, and a runbook for re-running locally
Benchmarks show at least one safe quantized variant that achieves >=1.8x token throughput at <=2% relative quality regression for our representative long-context conversational eval set
run_matrix: Variants: fp16 (baseline), fp8-e4m3, fp8-e5m2, int8-symmetric, int8-asymmetric
Batch sizes: 1,2,4,8,16 (continuous batching simulation + burst scenarios)
Workloads: single-shot generation, multi-turn chat with KV warmups, streaming incremental decode
Calibration modes: per-layer minmax, KL-divergence minimization, hybrid A+per-channel fallback
Metrics: token/sec, latency P50/P95/P99, memory GPU util, perplexity delta, exact-match/ROUGE deltas, token bias histogram
comments: 2026-03-05 Asha Patel: Initial ticket created. Outlined scope and acceptance criteria. Suggested using the conv_eval_long dataset as canonical accuracy set and the internal load-generator for batching realism.
2026-03-06 Ravi Kapoor: Spun up prototype calibration pipeline. Observed FP8-e4m3 numeric instability on layer norm outputs with default clip. Added per-layer stats collection to debug.

2026-03-08 Miguel Torres (review): Recommended adding symmetric INT8 as a baseline and capturing token-level bias histograms (rare token amplification). Also requested run seeds and RNG determinism notes.

2026-03-10 Ravi Kapoor: Wire-up complete for calibration -> profile export. First perf sweep completed for batch sizes [1,4,8] at ctx=2048. Preliminary results uploaded to GCS. FP8-e5m2 shows stable latency but ~3.6% perplexity regression on conv_eval_long.
2026-03-12 Design review (Priya Nair): UX ask to include clear variant labels and recommended default variant for Hosted customers in docs. Linked to DOC-1145 UX ticket.

2026-03-13 Asha Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to include pass/fail thresholds and runbook requirement. Flagging need for a follow-up ENG ticket to automate model rollouts if variant passes (potential rollout automation integration).

2026-03-14 Ravi Kapoor: Started large sweep (ctx 8192) on dedicated cluster; estimated completion 2026-03-17. Noted a scheduler hotspot when many small batches create KV cache thrashing — added as an instrumentation item.
decision_log: 2026-03-07 Decided to treat FP16 baseline as canonical quality reference rather than full-precision float because production uses mixed-precision kernels.
2026-03-09 Chose to keep both per-channel and per-tensor calibration artifacts to evaluate trade-offs between size and accuracy.
2026-03-11 Opted for BigQuery schema for aggregated metrics to enable cross-run comparisons and percentile joins in dashboards
open_questions: Should we include 4-bit quant variants in the same pipeline or keep them in a separate experimental track?
What is the appropriate customer-facing quality threshold (relative vs absolute) for recommending a quantized variant in Console suggestions?
Do we want to enable calibration on-device in Private deployments, or provide curated calibration profiles only?
